name: Child Safe — Parental Control & Kiosk Launcher
tagline: Total peace of mind for your child's digital world: Kiosk Mode, weekly usage quotas, real-time GPS tracking, and tamper-proof Device Owner security.
description:
Manage screen time, block distractions, track live location, and enforce tamper-proof safety controls remotely from your phone. Built on enterprise Android Device Owner (DPM) architecture for 100% reliability.

Key Pillars & Capabilities

📌 Kiosk Mode Launcher

Replace default home screen with approved apps only. Prevents policy bypasses with an offline 4-digit recovery PIN.

⏳ Weekly Screen Time Quotas

Configure custom daily hour/minute allowances for weekdays vs. weekends, with scheduled bedtime lockouts.

📍 Real-Time GPS & Routes

Live position updates and periodic route history logs (5m to 24h interval snapshots) powered by FusedLocation API.

🛡️ 50+ Hardware Restrictions

Block factory reset, Wi-Fi changes, USB file transfer, ADB debugging, camera/microphone toggles, and screenshot captures.

🔑 Smart PIN & Biometrics

Rhythm-based typing pattern analysis defense and fingerprint unlock safeguard master parent configurations.

🔒 100% Anti-Uninstall Security

Powered by Android Enterprise Device Owner (DPM) policies. Cannot be force-stopped, uninstalled, or bypassed.

Deep-Dive Features

📌 Kiosk Space & Launcher Pinning

Transform any Android phone or tablet into a dedicated learning device. In Kiosk Mode, the standard launcher, notification panel, recent apps, and system settings are completely locked out. Parents specify exactly which apps are visible on the child’s home screen.

  • Home screen replacement with high-contrast clock and custom app grid
  • Emergency 4-digit offline exit PIN triggered by long-pressing "KIOSK SPACE"
  • Instant remote toggling from the Parent Dashboard

⏳ Daily & Weekly Usage Quotas

Set strict limits on school nights and extend screen time allowance on weekends.

  • Individual day-of-week hour and minute pickers
  • Scheduled device usage locks (e.g., lock device from 9:00 PM to 7:00 AM)
  • Emergency dialing and whitelisted essential apps bypass the lock screen automatically

📍 Real-Time GPS & Periodic Route History

Stay connected with high-accuracy location tracking powered by Google Maps and FusedLocation API.

  • Instant on-demand real-time position updates
  • Scheduled periodic route snapshots (intervals from 5 mins to 24 hours)
  • Battery-optimized location tracking

🛡️ 50+ System & Hardware Restrictions

Locks down hardware and system settings to prevent kids from altering configurations:

  • Disallow factory reset & account modification
  • Disallow Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Airplane Mode, & Cellular state changes
  • Disallow USB file transfer, developer debugging, & APK installation from unknown sources
  • Disallow camera toggle, microphone toggle, and screen content capture

🔑 Smart PIN & Biometric Access

Even if your child learns your 4-digit PIN by watching over your shoulder, Child Safe's Smart PIN technology analyzes keystroke timing patterns. If the entry rhythm doesn't match yours, access is denied. Fingerprint and face unlock are also supported.

🚀 Setup & Provisioning Guide

Method 1: Standard QR Code Recommended

Best for new devices or fresh setups after a factory reset. Provides 100% tamper-proof Device Owner protection.

  1. Factory Reset Device: Start on initial "Welcome" screen.
  2. Trigger QR Scanner: Tap 6 times rapidly on any blank space.
  3. Scan Enrollment QR Code: Scan the QR code from Parent Dashboard.
  4. Connect Wi-Fi & Auto Install: Connect to Wi-Fi to auto-download and provision.
  5. Sign In & Link Profile: Select Kid, enter child's name, and manage!
Method 2: Advanced ADB No Reset Required

Best for tech-savvy users wanting to set up an active device without erasing personal data.

  1. Enable USB Debugging in Settings > Developer Options.
  2. Remove all Google and user accounts temporarily in Settings > Accounts.
  3. Connect phone to PC with ADB and run command:
adb shell dpm set-device-owner control.child.device/.admin.AdminReceiver

Once Success is returned, re-add Google accounts and launch Child Safe.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Can my child bypass Child Safe or force uninstall it?

No. When provisioned as Device Owner, system policy rules explicitly disallow app uninstallation, force stopping, or clearing app data without parent authorization.

What happens if the child device has no internet connection?

Active policies, time limits, and Kiosk app blocks continue enforcing locally on the device via Room DB. The parent can also exit Kiosk mode manually on the child device using the offline 4-digit Recovery PIN.

Can my child still make emergency calls if the device is locked?

Yes! Emergency numbers (such as 911/112) and any essential apps specifically whitelisted by parents remain accessible at all times.

Why do I need to tap 6 times for QR setup?

Tapping 6 times on the initial Android "Welcome" screen is the built-in Android Enterprise framework gesture to activate the hidden Device Owner QR code camera scanner.
